videos.title: Germany's AfD Scores Best-Ever Result in State Election
videos.description: Far-right party Alternative for Germany (AfD) scored its best-ever result in a state election in Saxony-Anhalt, securing 44% of the vote on Sunday. This comes amid growing public discontent with the political establishment and delivers a powerful blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Bloomberg's Oliver Crook reports. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Dangote Aims to Raise $1.6 Bln in Nigeria's Biggest IPO
videos.description: Billionaire Aliko Dangote is seeking to raise $1.6 billion in what would be Nigeria’s biggest initial public offering. Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE is offering 4.1 billion shares at 525 naira ($0.40) each, a company spokesman said Friday. The IPO will open on Sept. 14. Bloomberg's Anthony Osae-Brown reports. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
